operator_statement: I adjudicate the Cycle-006 Gate-P specification defect and accept the revision-2 pool-entry criteria, the revision-2 successor preregistration, and the revision-2 CI-line derivation worksheet as one unit. This record supersedes the revision-1 Gate-P acceptance record sha256:3af84045ee41d487e9e2dc5e063cbe4fb1decc8e91f77d58e63348bc0e1e8bc4, which is preserved unchanged and no longer authorizes any survey act. Every source-universe entry now carries one fixed enumeration_index_url, which is the sole authority for discovering product families; the declared_root remains authority and navigation provenance. A product family is a provider-named leaf API or machine-readable data service in that fixed index, applied before any admission criterion, and never chosen by cadence, history, admissibility, expected yield, or pool sufficiency. I authorize materialization and verification of the Gate-P-fixed package only. I do not authorize candidate enumeration, survey execution, provider contact, pool construction, successor freeze, commit, push, landing, or LU-2B. A complete revision-2 re-survey from portal 1 is mandatory once this reissued authority is landed; no revision-1 reading, enumeration, or partial disposition may be reused.

supersedes.reason: the revision-1 product-family discovery rule was under-determined — it defined a surveyable product by a disjunction over the declared root or an official product/service index that was never declared for any portal, with no rule for choosing a limb when the two exposed different granularities. The under-determination was outcome-determining. Revision 2 fixes one enumeration index per portal and one provider-taxonomy product-family definition.
